text:
Maria Chen: Quick kickoff — we need to align on roles/entitlements + AMI/VM naming and trial SKU mapping for the AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Who owns each piece?

Ajay Patel: I can own SKU/trial mapping. Quick Q: are we doing 14-day or 30-day trials for the public listing?

Maria Chen: prefer 14 for marketplace (reduces abuse), but open to 30 on AWS private offers. @Sarah Law can confirm legal constraints.

Sarah Law: 14 days is fine from a legal standpoint. Need localized EULA links and compliance checklist for EU customers. I'll drop the checklist doc in Confluence.

Luke Park: I'll take AMI/VM image naming + artifact manifest. For reproducibility we should enforce tags: `redwood:build=<git-sha>`, `redwood:region=us-east-1` etc. Also need final AMI/VM id per cloud before publishing.

Tony Gomez: I'll coordinate packaging with the cloud partner contacts. For Azure we need the managed image doc and a publisher ID — I have a contact at partner-ops@azure.

Ajay Patel: For SKU mapping: propose two SKUs — `rwd-enterprise-trial` (14d, limited concurrency) and `rwd-paid-monthly` (metered). Anyone object?

Sarah Law: add clause about trial activation being timebound and non-renewing. Also confirm data residency callouts for GCP EU regions.

marketplace-bot: Automated check: missing `publisher_identity` field in manifest. See: https://confluence.redwood/example-marketplace-manifest

Luke Park: pushing a sample manifest below — please review and comment.

Luke Park: ```json
{
  "name": "redwood-inference",
  "publisher_identity": "redwood-inference-co",
  "images": {
    "aws": "ami-0abc123def456",
    "gcp": "gcp-image-2024-03-01",
    "azure": "azure-image-v1"
  },
  "tags": ["redwood:build=af3d9c","redwood:stack=inference"],
  "trial_sku": "rwd-enterprise-trial"
}
```

Maria Chen: thanks. Action items:
- Maria: consolidate this thread into a short onboarding checklist and assign owners (today EOD).
- Ajay: finalize SKU IDs + trial limits (tomorrow).
- Luke: finalize AMI/VM IDs and upload manifest to S3 + share link (48h).
- Sarah: post EULA/localization checklist in Confluence and call out EU/UK differences (48h).
- Tony: confirm Azure publisher contact and any extra required artifacts (48h).

Tony Gomez: noted — I'll ping the Azure contact and share any publisher shortfalls.

Ajay Patel: I'll draft a small telemetry policy blurb to include in the listing (what we send during trial).

Sarah Law: please include that telemetry note in the Confluence doc so legal can sign off.

Maria Chen: perfect. tagging owners in the onboarding doc once it's up. :white_check_mark:

Luke Park: one more ask — can infra create a temp artifact bucket with `marketplace-ingest-stage` prefix so we can hand off AMIs? cc @marketplace-bot for automation.

marketplace-bot: Created staging bucket: `s3://marketplace-ingest-stage-1723456789` and generated short-lived upload creds (expires in 24h).

Maria Chen: great — that'll speed things up. If nothing else, we'll reconvene in this thread with final links.

Ajay Patel: will post SKU mapping and limits here when done.

Luke Park: will post final AMI IDs here.

Sarah Law: will confirm EULA links and post Confluence link.

Tony Gomez: will post Azure publisher ID + contact card.

Maria Chen: thanks all — nice momentum. :rocket:
